messages.subject: Stan users meetup in Cambridge, MA on Tuesday, 9/22
parts:
For any Stan users in the Cambridge / Boston area, there's a meetup happening on Tuesday, 9/22, at 6 pm at Harvard.

Sign up here: http://www.meetup.com/Stan-Users-Boston-Camberville/events/225068062/

At least a couple of the core developers will be there (Allen Riddell -- PyStan; Dustin Tran -- ADVI). Thanks to Lizzie Wolkovich for arranging the meetup!


Daniel
